symptom: `rename module Old to New` left `[Old.Contract_Company = $Company]` (incl. inside not(...)) in database-retrieve XPath, and `@Old.Constant` in expressions, naming the old module; mx check then failed with CE1613 (ako/mxcli#2590, mendixlabs/mxcli#1948).
cause: execRenameModule calls RenameReferences with the bare module name (and 'Old.'). The sweep rewrote whole strings equal to or prefixed by 'Old.', and RewriteExpressionReferences — the only rewrite inside expression/XPath text — requires a qualified old name and documented that a module rename is not handled. View-entity OQL had the same gap.
fix: RewriteModulePrefix rewrites `Old.` + name as a whole token (not after a name char, `.` or `$`; after `/` and `@` it is a path step or constant) outside string literals; the sweep applies it to every string and to OQL when the old name is a bare module name.
insight: A rewriter that documents what it does not handle ('neither is handled here') is a list of open bugs: the module-rename case was written down as out of scope and never picked up. Check the caller's arguments against the callee's preconditions — execRenameModule passes a bare name that RewriteExpressionReferences rejects at its first line.
